tabContent.title: Week 1
content: Get acquainted with the course objectives and structure.
Learn how to install Visual Studio Code, a popular code editor used for web development.
Discover useful shortcuts and productivity features in Visual Studio Code.

tabContent.title: Weeks 2
content: Gain a solid understanding of HTML (Hypertext Markup Language) by exploring basic HTML tags and their usage.
Differentiate between block and inline elements. Learn how to work with elements, attributes, classes, and IDs.
Implementing FavIcons for branding and visual appeal.
Incorporating various media elements such as audio, video, and images into web pages and adding quotations to enhance content presentation.

tabContent.title: Weeks 3
content: Create interactive forms for user input
Employ entities for special characters and symbols

tabContent.title: Weeks 4
content: Understand the role of CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) in web development. Master CSS syntax and its application.
Select and style HTML elements using CSS selectors. Annotate your CSS code effectively with comments.
Manipulate colors to create appealing designs. Customize backgrounds with colors, images, and gradients.

tabContent.title: Weeks 5
content: Control margins, padding, height, and width of elements. Arrange elements in layers using z-index. Position elements precisely on web pages.
Create flexible layouts with the power of Flexbox.

tabContent.title: Weeks 6
content: Dive into JavaScript, a powerful programming language for web development. Understand JavaScript syntax and fundamental concepts. Annotate JavaScript code using comments.
Declare and manipulate variables to store and retrieve data.
Perform calculations and comparisons using arithmetic, assignment, and comparison operators.
Explore different data types in JavaScript and learn useful string methods.

tabContent.title: Weeks 7
content: Work with arrays to store and manipulate collections of data.
Implement conditional statements (if, else, else if, switch) for decision-making.
Create reusable code blocks using functions.
Manipulate and display dates dynamically with in web pages.
